chapters.label: Off the bench
chapters.text: Munich, 2015. Bayern trail Wolfsburg one–nil at half-time. On comes Robert Lewandowski. One: a toe-poke. Two: a long shot. Three: a rebound. Four: a volley. Five: a flying volley! Five goals in nine minutes!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch number five again, slowly. Mario Götze crosses. Lewandowski is already in the right place, leaps, and volleys it first time!

chapters.label: Goal one
chapters.text: Goal one was simple too: close to goal, one quick poke, and in!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: stay ready, be in the right place, and keep your finish quick and simple.
